page.overview:
What is Daikos?

Daikos is a fictional location in the Cthulhu Mythos. It was originally created by the late American author H. P. Lovecraft for his short story "Polaris".

Daikos is a city in the far northern kingdom of Lomar in the Dreamlands. It was sacked by the invading hordes of the Inutos, leaving the way open for their assault on the city of Olathoë. (: "Polaris")
